decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (RI/CH/10, RI/CH/11, RI/CH/12, RI/CH/13, RI/CH/14, RI/CH/15, RI/CH/113 PA3 and RI/CH/1250 Received: 03 May 2012 RI/CH/110, RI/CH/111, RI/CH/114, RI/CH/115, RI/CH/116 Received: 28 June 2012) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The window formed in the southern elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area around the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the
Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a first floor rear extension above proposed rear extension to the house which was granted planning permission on 22/09/2011 (ref: 00787/65/P3).
